# Discovery rendering repair

- Crop category artwork from the original sprite. The old crop helper appended a crop to an already resized URL, returning the wrong part of the image or blank artwork.
- Use the site's inline SVG icons for directory topics and offer topics; provide an icon tile when a topic has no matching venue photo.
- Handle the AGC menu's `/?view=agc`, `/?explore=agc`, `/agc`, `/adult-gaming-centres`, and legacy destination query routes with the shared directory.
- Render the shared footer as responsive text and links instead of a cropped screenshot.
- Resolve the search dialog across the separate header and footer shadow roots.
- Request directory card photos at 640px / q65 rather than 1400px / q90.
- Replace the body-wide 15-second visibility hold with a temporary guard on the obsolete Wix container. New page roots are visible as soon as mounted.
- Load a 50 KB gzip discovery bundle on an explicit category-route allowlist, instead of the 294 KB gzip rest bundle. Other routes retain their existing bundles.

## Verification

Run syntax checks with `node --check` on the source and generated bundles.
For isolated DOM regression checks, install `jsdom` in a temporary test directory (do not add it to Wix production dependencies), then:

```
NODE_PATH=/tmp/sr-tests/node_modules node tools/verify-discovery.cjs
NODE_PATH=/tmp/sr-tests/node_modules node tools/verify-discovery-bundle.cjs
```

Checks cover 19 category renders, 182 crop URLs, structural validation of 2,043 rendered links, 12 directory routes, split-shadow search, and 10 complete core-plus-discovery bundle routes. These do not replace live checks of CMS responses or remote link destinations.

## Deployment

Use the committed bundles, pin the loader URLs to that commit, and put `paint-hold.html` before `wix-loader-snippet.html` in the existing active loader embed. Do not enable the disabled legacy snippets. Do not use Wix API/CLI publishing (see README); this repair needs only the existing custom-code loader update.

## Search and map follow-up

- Search category filters and all 15 map categories/markers now use shared inline SVG icons. No external icon download is required.
- Map place queries start independently of Leaflet. A slow map script no longer blocks the place list. Script loading times out after 10 seconds and preserves a usable list with an accurate status.
- Footer descriptive text has an explicit readable 16px size.
- Shared topic matching distinguishes theme parks and destinations correctly.
- All 37 unique shared header/footer navigation URLs returned HTTP 200 after redirects. Manufacturer URL redirects to the archive; retained existing behavior. These checks do not validate every listing's external destination.
- Passed category rendering, 12 directory routes, 10 integrated discovery routes, search category filtering, delayed map library, SVG markers, and failed map library fallback.
- Request durations from the execution network are not browser performance metrics; no blanket page-speed guarantee is made.

## Archive loading follow-up

Wix Site Speed, mobile real-visitor report for Aug 31–Sep 29, showed archive LCP 20.8s (113 sessions) and map LCP 13.1s (67 sessions). These historical figures predate this deployment and are not an after-change measurement.

The archive now paints featured/hero content from its first 100 records while remaining 500-record batches load. Previously it waited for the entire archive. Cards use 640px requests instead of 1400px. Hero markup stays stable through subsequent batches. Shared SVGs replace legacy archive tab glyphs. The isolated test holds the second request pending and verifies early content, then checks complete pagination and stable hero markup.

The Wix loader also limits its four homepage-image preload tags to the homepage without query parameters. Other pages retain only their relevant image preload.
